fixes.explanation: Creative, baker, and Jesus was passing through Jericho (Luke 19:1). But the people said, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!” (Luke 19:7) Nobody in that crowd is griping about being passed by. They're griping that Jesus is going home with Zacchaeus.

The courts never come up in the text. Zacchaeus says, “…if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.” (Luke 19:8) Nobody is dragging him anywhere. He's the one standing up and making the promise, and the amount is four times what was taken.
